page: Google Cloud Platform a3-highgpu-8g is an accelerator-optimized instance designed for large-scale distributed machine learning training, complex artificial intelligence modeling, and massive parallel compute tasks. It is powered by 208 dedicated vCPUs from Intel Xeon 8481C processors running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz across 104 physical cores on the x86_64 architecture. Memory configuration is substantial, supplying 1872 GB of system RAM, which provides 9.0 GB per physical core. Compute capabilities are augmented by hardware features including Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) and AVX-512 vector instructions.

The primary computing power stems from eight bundled NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPUs delivering an aggregate of 640 GB high-bandwidth GPU memory. System I/O is supported by 6432 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage, providing high-throughput scratch space necessary to maintain low latency during heavy batch transfers. Network access does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, which reflects its typical placement within private high-throughput cluster VPC networks.

Performance benchmarks confirm top-tier multi-threaded processing and system throughput. The server achieved top-decile scores in multi-core stress-ng tests, PassMark CPU tests, and Redis SET throughput reaching 179.39 million operations per second. Memory bandwidth benchmarks recorded 426.55 GB/s on large uncached read operations. Ray tracing and extended vector instruction benchmarks also placed in the top 10 percent. Single-threaded metrics, including stress-ng single-core, remain in the middle tier, demonstrating that workload scaling depends on parallel execution rather than individual core clock speed.

Cost efficiency is focused on high resource density and maximum hardware utilization. Consolidating eight flagship enterprise GPUs, two hundred dedicated vCPUs, and over 1.8 TB of RAM into a single chassis prevents the cluster management overhead and interconnect bottlenecks common to distributed multi-node setups. Google Cloud Platform a3-highgpu-8g is primarily suited for large language model pre-training, fine-tuning, high-throughput distributed inference pipelines, and intensive scientific high-performance computing simulations.
description: Google Cloud Platform a3-highgpu-8g is an accelerator-optimized compute instance tailored for enterprise-scale artificial intelligence and distributed high-performance computing. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8481C processor with 208 dedicated vCPUs and 1872 GB of system memory, the instance integrates eight NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPUs totaling 640 GB of VRAM. Bundled with 6432 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, the architecture delivers top-tier parallel compute, demonstrated by leading multi-core benchmark results, 179.39 million Redis SET operations per second, and exceptional ray-tracing capabilities. Supported by Advanced Matrix Extensions and extensive memory bandwidth exceeding 426 GB/s on uncached reads, the platform offsets single-core performance trade-offs through high multi-threaded scaling. The a3-highgpu-8g instance is suited for foundational LLM training, complex transformer inference, computer vision processing, and deep learning research workloads requiring massive sustained GPU acceleration.
